socket_path.description: Absolute remote-host agent socket. Registration lasts until this API connection closes.

command_id.description: Opaque endpoint-issued command identifier from the client-shell projection.

selection.description: Client-owned selection coordinates, validated against the pane's content revision.

ClientShellSurfaceSetParams.description: Updates whether the requesting client shell receives and controls pane presentation.

source_workspace_id.description: Workspace whose focused pane supplies the `follow` cwd policy.

reuse_root.description:
Reuse the space that already stands for this directory instead of
creating a second one.

Only the agent panel's "open a history session" path sets this. Manual
space creation leaves it false, so deliberately creating a second space
for the same directory stays allowed.

AgentSessionDeleteParams.description:
A session to remove.

The agent travels with the path because the store that owns the path is also
the one that knows how to remove an entry from it; the daemon routes the
request to that store instead of deciding anything from the path itself.

name.description:
Optional: the server names the agent after its space, kind and tab when
this is absent, so the panel and the command line share one rule.

resume_session.description:
Session id to resume. When present the server replaces `args` with the
agent's own resume argv, so a client does not need to know that agent's
flags.

timeout_ms.description: Startup timeout in milliseconds. Values must be greater than 3000 and at most 300000.

resume_argv.description:
Command that resumes this agent's session after a Herdr restart. The
first element must be a plain command name.

Command that resumes this agent's session after a Herdr restart. The
first element must be a plain command name.

oneOf.description: Outer popup size in terminal cells, including the border.
Outer popup size as a percentage of the terminal area, for example 80%.

Acknowledgement for the client-shell surface interest lease. This method is new on the
endpoint protocol, so its revision-bearing result can establish an activation floor.

endpoint_protocol_generation.description: Stable client-owned endpoint generation supported by this server.

surface_interest.description: Whether this server supports explicit client-shell surface interest.

health_check.description: Whether this server supports endpoint health probes.

ssh_agent_registration.description: Supports connection-scoped `server.ssh_agent.register` on the local JSON API.

branch.description: Current branch of the workspace's repository, when it has one.

ahead.description: Commits the branch is ahead of its upstream, when that is known.

behind.description: Commits the branch is behind its upstream, when that is known.

completion_seq.description: The current idle transition completed work, independently of who has viewed it.

RawSessionDto.description:
One historical agent session as scanned by the daemon. The daemon only
collects: dedup, ordering, pin/archive state and open-session filtering
all live in the panel.

workspace_root.description:
Working directory the session ran in; matched against workspace
identity cwds by the daemon.

workspace_id.description: `Some` = the space this session belongs to is open.

deletable.description:
Whether the store this session came from can remove one entry. Decided
where the store is registered, so the panel never guesses from a path.

warnings.description:
Warnings collected at link time or on registry load (e.g. unknown event names,
missing manifest file). Non-fatal — the entry is kept and surfaced by plugin.list.

Outer popup size as a percentage of the terminal area, for example 80%.

PaneLinkRegion.description: Inclusive display-cell columns on a pane's current viewport.

behind.description: Commits the branch is behind its upstream, when that is known.
